newsitem.title: MALTA: Malta government says to borrow up to $264 mln. [CORRECTED 17:20 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Malta government says to borrow up to $264 mln. [CORRECTED 17:20 GMT]

text.p: (Corrects dollar figure in headline and text from $38 mln)
The government of Malta has published a bill to authorise it to raise loans up to 100 million Maltese pounds ($264 million) both locally and abroad.
Up to 75 million pounds may be appropriated to make good for the budget deficit of 1996 and up to 25 million pounds may be appropriated to be loaned to state-owned Malta Drydocks.

The bill, expected to be debated in parliament later this month, authorises the finance minister to borrow the money under the Development Loan Act, in respect of loans raised outside Malta, or under the Local Loans (Registered Stock and Securities) Ordinances, in order to issue stock in Malta.
